ENTERING A FANTASY WORLD - Prophecy is fulfilling. People don’t care, don’t think and satan has them swallowed up mind, soul, and body into a make believe world. They are in for a rude awakening soon. We are living in a time that everything goes or is all right. We are in an age of quad x-rated society of immorality, violence, and wickedness! A sign of Jesus’ return! In other words they are in a maze, blinded by materialistic cares of this life etc. and can not find the door. (Jesus) - Rev.3:17 gives a good example of this!

VITAL SUPER FUTURISTIC GLANCE - Somewhere in spring 2001 through summer 2003 the earth and society will have gone through the most drastic changes ever! Astonishing occurrences and astonishment among the population will overwhelm the planet. Plus, cataclysmic and apocalyptic catastrophes concerning the travailing of the elements will be staggering! Indeed a complete new era than ever before! Every facet of this world will be different economics, religion, politics, etc. Technology, movies, and etc...

THE GREAT MAZZAROTH - Job.38:33-35 - The celestial - is what the heavens are uttering their voices of the heavenly and the things that will be afterwards! (Ps.19 - Luke 21:25) The news media is carrying the headlines daily of what God has known from the beginning and said in His Holy Spirit Word! And The Scripts are fulfilling daily. Since January and especially since April and May, some most unusual activity above took place! Some not seen like this in hundreds of years. Rare indeed. Portents, shew forth things affecting the world, through the years 2005- 7. Then again in July and August of this year, a trio of things take place which have not occured like this in decades! This definitely shows us the most vital events forth coming the rest of this year and beyond..We have listed some on the Scripts that you can check. - Luke 21:11 will also be fulfilling. Some awesome and major mysteries, some unexpected shock waves! God's restoration spirit will be working swiftly on His children!

THE GREAT RED DRAGON - (Rev.12:3-4) - This predicts the prehistoric fall of Lucifer and his angels and his futuristic state on the earth with the anti-christ in Rev.13:3-4. This final look is when the mark of the beast is given, the latter part of the tribulation and Armageddon! - Now China has been called a dragon, but its only a part of satan the old dragon’s earthly empire for a short moment. China is already trading with most nations, but now they are allowing her to enter world trade! Also, all of Asia is. So now we already see the kings of the east prepare. (Rev.16:12-13) - After much turmoil they will enter a peace treaty, but later it will split and the east and west will collide! China already has stolen much of our secret weapons and later will turn the technology upon the western world. Watch for the world to make drastic and tremendous changes among the nations in the next few years! The celestial is already forewarning of the near future and of the final wind up, the above a vital sign and below. A decay of decade!

PROPHECY - NATURE TRAVAILING - The 4 elements will be raging on as a sign. Fire, wind, earth, and water! Plus, volcanic activity will continue loosening the continental shelves, land, sea, and cities! Super quakes of Biblical proportions will start. Lives and buildings destroyed. Mighty winds and great water hurricanes etc. will occur! - Note: God’s 7 thunders are now working with the midnight cry as the former and latter rain merge together to take out the elect. Behold, | come quickly! Blessed is he that watcheth and are active in preparation!
CONTINUING - The terrorists will not hesitate in the future to spread pestilence, biological diseases and destructive methods on the USA and other nations!
CONTINUING PROPHECY - The scripts predicted unusual events associated to the upcoming election and afterwards. Already we have seen some strange twists before the final part of it.

APOCALYPTIC FORECAST - The spirit speaketh expressively for the world will be hanging in the balance! Note: This could mean a lot of things - axis turning, apocalypse, dictatorship, etc. Armageddon war - Pentecost given 1904-05 - The outpouring 2001-2010 - (Jews took control of old city 1967) - if you add 40 year generation you come up with 2007 - Covenant possible translation from now until then. The world is right for the predicted coming calamities, and great shall the cry of the earth be!

IMPORTANT PROPHECY FULFILLING - The news reported the INX nations were united in going forward with their plans. And mentioned them as the 10 nations (Kings) in Western Europe. We see the revived Roman Empire coming into place! Also, England and Germany merged in a technological trade association including Asia. Plus, we see Russia and Israel just changed leaders! The USA will change and so will the Vatican soon. New era appearing as the scripts said.

EVENTS TRANSPIRING - Fantasy, illusion, and phantasm, these pied pipers are leading our kids into delusion! Today, sorcery and electronic magic bring higher levels of witchcraft to music and motion pictures. We have the music cults exalting the #666, the mark and the anti-christ and the worst sorcery we have seen in history. A nation of wizardry!
This below was written over a decade ago and we print in part:

CONTINUING - “What is occurring in the past is transpiring today. For instance, Quote: “All over the world, including American cities, there are ‘churches’ dedicated to the worship involves actual communication with evil spirits and with ‘principalities and powers. Here the whole atmosphere is charged with terror and nausea!”

CONTINUING - The Black Mass - “Often the devotees use a ruined or deserted church, sometimes an overgrown cemetery. Their ritual begins at eleven o'clock at night, aiming to finish at twelve. Central to the ceremony is an alter, with black cloth, six black candles, a chalice, and crucifix turned upside down! The altar is a naked women lying on a table and holding black candles in her hands. The priest consecrates the host on her bare stomach. The Black Mass is the Roman Catholic Mass repeated verbatim, with the word Satan substituted for Christ! The Roman Catholic host is often stolen from the real Mass in a handkerchief! The high point of the ritual comes when the priest has intercourse with the girl on the alter, an act often accompanied by crude sadism! Many such evenings end with drunken dancing, drug taking, and a general sex orgy; often the next day there are found skinned cats, beheaded chickens, or ritual bags containing drugs, potions, animal bones, and occasionally human fingers!” As the writer stated, when one reached this stage of occult practices the color is no longer gray, but midnight black!

CONTINUING - “This planet is entering the last stages of demonism and orgies. There is coming yet another dimension of immorality wherein Satan and evil spirits join in union with mankind with an orgy of debauchery that has not yet been seen! - Also Hollywood has not reached its ultimate in filmmaking concerning sex gods (evil spirits) in intimacy with men and women! - Jesus said it would be like the days of Noah and Lot. And those days are running out in the decade! Astonishing and alarming events will appear!... All we speak about in this script will be intermingled in Babylon.” (Rev. 18:2) - Where is found the cage of every type devil known! - Cases have already been documented wherein women and men have had intercourse with certain type devil spirits actually feeling them as physical and in instances appearing in form! - We will not mention the unseemly acts that occur in these types of lurid unions! - Hollywood is beginning to portray some of this but is yet to reach its final peak in things to come! - (What the Scripts predicted is definitely occurring around us!) When they portray the ultimate in the film empire it will be viler than what occurred in Sodom!” - Note: The above sounds horrific, but the worst is yet to come. The Tribulation - even worse!
